target.description: Target agent: full address (alice/researcher@https://relay.example), or a short form (researcher, alice/researcher) completed locally. Call consult_targets first to list reachable agents.

question.description: Question text. Ask in abstract terms by default; the text goes through the outbound redaction pipeline before delivery.

scopeHint.description: Optional tag-path scopes to draw material from (for example finance/reports). Omit it unless the answer must quote your notes; scopes outside the pre-authorized whitelist fall back to manual review.

waitSeconds.description: Optional wait window in seconds to block until the reply arrives (10-120 recommended). When the answer lands inside the window it is returned directly and you can present it in the same turn; on timeout you get the delivery receipt and the answer still arrives asynchronously.
